title: Stetson Bennett IV seems to be ready to serve as Matthew Stafford's understudy

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Stetson Bennett IV seems to be ready to serve as Matthew Stafford's understudy
sources.description: Two years ago, with Rams backup quarterback Jimmy Garoppolo due to miss the first two games of the regular season because of a PED suspension, the Rams weren't sure Stetson Bennett IV was ready to serve as the understudy to Matthew Stafford.
